data.name: Aaliyaan
data.gender_notes: Aaliyaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alaa', meaning 'to rise up'. The name Aaliyaan signifies one who is exalted or noble in character and status. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is known as 'Al-A'la' (the Most High) due to his lofty status and noble character. The name Aaliyaan carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaliyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be close to Allah and live a noble and virtuous life.
data.etymology: Aaliyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaliyaan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Aaliyaan is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ل ي', which signifies elevation, exaltation, and high status. The name Aaliyaan thus carries connotations of nobility, distinction, and aspirational excellence.
